name: orders.list
description: The customer's past and current orders, newest first, optionally filtered.

minTotal.description: Only orders whose total is at least this many dollars.
minTotal.label: of ${value:g} or more

maxTotal.description: Only orders whose total is at most this many dollars.
maxTotal.label: up to ${value:g}

item.description: Only orders containing a product whose name includes this text (e.g. a product type).
item.label: containing "{value}"

placedSince.description: Only orders placed on or after this date, as YYYY-MM-DD.
placedSince.label: placed since {value:date}

limit.description: Show only this many of the most recent orders.
